example.title: Old Enon Road Stone Arch Culvert, Rocky Point Road over Mud Run
example.place: Mad River Township (east of Enon), Clark County, OH
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Old Enon Road Stone Arch Culvert)

brief: Single semicircular stone arch culvert of perhaps 6 ft span through a deep rubble-and-block headwall, carrying a narrow one-lane country road over a small wooded run. Rough-coursed grey limestone with a squared voussoir ring, stepped wing walls; the parapets are replaced by W-beam guardrail on timber posts with striped end markers, and a weight-limit sign stands at the approach. 19th-century masonry (date not given in the sources); shown in winter snow among bare trees.
